Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

GDPval · evaluates: GDPval’s paper marks 12 of its 220 public tasks as ungradable because of automated-grader limitations and describes the experimental grader as a limited proxy for occupational-expert judgment.

Permanent record ID: candidate.normal12.gdpval.automated-grader-limits.v2

  • The 12-task exclusion is specific to automated grading, not a removal from the logical benchmark inventory.
  • The grader’s no-internet/Python-only setting and file-format limitations differ from the human-evaluation protocol.

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

GDPval · human annotation: GDPval task authors were occupational experts with at least four years of relevant experience; the paper describes background verification and a training quiz before creation of requests, reference files and deliverables.

Permanent record ID: candidate.normal12.gdpval.expert-authors.v2

  • This is the paper’s expert-selection protocol, not verification of every author’s employment or a named supplier contribution.

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

GDPval · evaluates: For the 220-task evaluation subset, GDPval compares model and expert deliverables through blinded pairwise judgments by occupational experts; the paper describes three completions of each model per task and three graders per completion, giving nine comparisons per task per model.

Permanent record ID: candidate.normal12.gdpval.pairwise-evaluation.v3

  • Blinding hid explicit author identity but stylistic clues could still reveal model authorship.
  • These are documented human-evaluation settings, not the automated grader’s scope or a ranking endorsed by this author.

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

GDPval · dataset size: GDPval’s paper describes 1,320 work tasks covering 44 occupations across nine sectors and states at least 30 tasks per occupation in the full set, with a public gold subset of 220 tasks, five per occupation.

Permanent record ID: candidate.normal12.gdpval.release-units.v3

  • The full corpus, public 220-task subset, occupations and reference files are different units; subsets do not create additional benchmark families.
  • Gold here is the paper authors’ name for their public task subset, not any ScienceToStartup audit reference.

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

GDPval · has stage: GDPval quality control uses model suggestions with experts retaining final responsibility, followed by iterative generalist review, occupation-specific expert review and a third expert’s feedback loop.

Permanent record ID: candidate.normal12.gdpval.review-workflow.v2

  • The models flagged possible issues and did not autonomously alter tasks.
  • The paper reports at least three human reviews and about five on average; no new review of task payloads was performed here.
